title: not simple
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ian, a young Australian from a broken family, travels to England and America chasing a running record and searching for his beloved sister Kylie. His story is told backwards, framed by Jim, a writer turning Ian's life into a novel called 'not simple'. A single-volume work by Natsume Ono, published in English by Viz.
life_message: The longing for family and an emotional home endures through every misfortune, even when it is never fulfilled.

delivery.evidence: Reviewer praises plausible, spare storytelling told backwards; no moralizing reported.

winners_losers: No one wins; Ian's longing goes largely unanswered, and sympathy rests with him and his sister against neglectful adults.
